summary: Added [Fact] method ExtractAsync_TraversalEntry_OrdinalComparison_RejectsEntry to ZipArchiveExtractorTests.cs using a runtime case-divergence scenario.

summary: Code review PASS for WP-008. The new test ExtractAsync_TraversalEntry_OrdinalComparison_RejectsEntry is a well-crafted regression gate that uses a runtime case-divergence scenario (../OUTPUT/evil.txt vs dest 'output') to verify Ordinal semantics.

The chosen approach is more robust than a code-pattern assertion: it proves the guard's runtime behavior under the exact scenario where Ordinal and OrdinalIgnoreCase diverge — upper-case vs. lower-case sibling directory. Portable across Windows and Linux.
XML doc summary fulfills the AC requirement and is thorough — documents the scenario, portability, and what regression would be caught if the comparison were weakened.
Production code in ZipArchiveExtractor.cs line 46 uses StringComparison.Ordinal. No blocking issues, no Fix-Forward changes applied.
